content.short: Pixieland is a TON game where players collect and breed Pixie NFTs, join challenges, and earn through the PIXIC ecosystem.
content.description: Pixieland is a TON game built around collectible Pixie NFTs, breeding, marketplace trading, staking, and challenge-based rewards. Its official site presents the project as a Telegram mini app with on-chain assets, free tasks for points, and a broader economy that includes PIXIC tokens, DAO participation, and future land and mini-game features. The core experience is centered on building a Pixie collection and using it across game activities rather than simple passive earning. That gives the app a stronger collection and progression loop than a typical points-only Telegram game.
content.meta: Pixieland is a TON game focused on Pixie NFTs, breeding, challenges, staking, and PIXIC based rewards through a Telegram mini app experience.
